home.hero_title: Protecting Brain Health Earlier, Accurately & Fairly
home.hero_desc: Traditional single-snapshot screening misdiagnoses up to 30% of normal adults due to language and education bias. BrainBaseline tracks personal changes over time against your own statistical baseline, checking for reversible medical causes before specialty referral.
home.pillar_1_desc: Evaluates you against your own established baseline, eliminating bias for low-literacy or non-native participants.
home.pillar_2_desc: Checks for sleep apnea, B12/thyroid deficiency, medication side effects, and sensory impairment before any diagnosis.
home.pillar_3_desc: Immediate bypass to emergency care if sudden weakness, speech trouble, or confusion is reported.
home.launchpad_subtitle: Select any clinical scenario to test live deterministic triage and Gate 5 holding behavior:

check.consent_desc: BrainBaseline tracks subtle cognitive shifts over time to support healthy aging. We protect your privacy and allow instant consent revocation.
check.consent_scope_cog: Consent for cognitive sequence & memory tracking
check.consent_scope_malaffi: Consent to connect Malaffi / FHIR health records for reversible risk analysis
check.red_flags_desc: Please indicate if you or a family member noticed any of the following sudden symptoms today:
check.rf_confusion: Sudden new confusion, disorientation, or delirium today
check.rf_speech: Sudden difficulty speaking or understanding words
check.rf_weakness: Sudden numbness, facial droop, or arm/leg weakness
check.rf_fall: Recent head injury or severe fall in the past 48 hours
check.context_desc: Temporary factors like poor sleep or illness directly affect test performance. Logging them prevents false alarms.
check.ctx_mood: Feeling unusually stressed, anxious, or down today
check.ctx_illness: Currently experiencing acute illness, cold, or fever
check.ctx_med: Started a new sedating medication or changed doses recently
check.tasks_desc: Complete the 3 short interactive tasks below. Standard demo completes in ~90 seconds.
check.function_desc: Compared with a year ago, have you noticed any changes in these daily activities?
